**What I cannot do:** None of the tools I have access to can change an Amazon account password. The Amazon tools available to me only handle account/profile viewing, product search, cart/ordering, orders/returns, and stored addresses/cards — there is no password-change API. Changing the Amazon Prime password has to be done by you directly through Amazon's account settings (amazon.com → Account → Login & security).

**What this means for the rest of the request:** If I texted your roommates that the password is now `Zlp9tir`, that would be premature — the password wouldn't actually be changed, and they'd try to log in with a password that isn't active. I don't want to misrepresent that.

**How I can help once you've done the change:**
1. You change the password to `Zlp9tir` on Amazon's site.
2. Tell me to go ahead, and I'll text your roommates with the new login details — but first I'll need to confirm **who** your roommates are (I can look up your contacts by the "roommate" relationship and show you the candidates) and the **exact message text** you want sent, since texts go out immediately with no recall.
